product.name: Graphic Design Platform
product.description: An online platform enabling users to create logos, social media posts, business cards, and other graphic designs using templates and editing tools.

product.name: Logo Maker
product.description: An online tool for designing logos with editable templates tailored for various business sectors, supporting Arabic and English.

product.name: Menu Design Templates
product.description: A collection of editable restaurant and cafe menu templates available online for free or at low cost.

product.name: Poster Maker
product.description: An online poster creation tool with customizable templates for various themes and industries, supporting Arabic fonts.

product.name: Resume (CV) Designer
product.description: An online tool for creating and editing professional resumes and infographic CVs with customizable templates.

product.name: Photo Effects and Editing Tools
product.description: Online tools for applying effects, removing backgrounds, cropping, merging, and adding text to images without software installation.
